channel.description: Latest articles from The Kyiv Independent (kyivindependent.com)

item.title: The problem with counting military losses in Russia's war
item.description: The Kyiv Independent’s Chris York speaks with Olha Polishchuk, a conflict data analyst who tracks military and civilian deaths in Russia’s war against Ukraine.

item.title: 1st Ukrainian drone factory starts production in UK, Zaluzhnyi says
item.description: Valerii Zaluzhnyi said the launch of Ukrainian drone company Ukrspecsystems' production in the U.K. has "a deep strategic logic" for integration into the British defense industry.

item.title: Kremlin dampens Witkoff's hopes for early Putin-Zelensky meeting
item.description: A Kremlin spokesperson questioned "whether there's any point in holding a summit" between Putin and Zelensky as long as the Ukrainian side maintains its current position in negotiations.

item.title: Zelensky, Trump hold phone call ahead of Ukraine-US talks in Geneva
item.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky held a phone call on Feb. 25 with his American counterpart Donald Trump ahead of planned talks between senior officials from both countries in Geneva.

item.title: 4 Ukrainian defense companies sign partnership deals with European allies valued at nearly $950 million
item.description: The Ukrainian Council of Defence Industry said the agreements include cooperation in the production of aerial and ground drones, as well as preparations to scale up products on the European market.

item.title: Suspect in murder of top Ukrainian ex-official arrested in Germany
item.description: The suspect in the murder of former Ukrainian top official Andriy Portnov was arrested in the German town of Heinsberg, Spanish National Police reported on Feb. 25.

item.title: Russia launches combined overnight missile and drone attack at Ukrainian cities
item.description: Russia launched a combined missile and drone attack across Ukraine early on Feb. 26, targeting Kyiv and other cities and causing damage to residential buildings and civilian infrastructure.
